description: Read an evidence item's files: list them, one file with its download URL, one file's validation result, or the organization's validation summary. Pick with method.

evidence_id.description: Evidence ID (e.g., 'ERL-IAM-001') — obtain from scf_list_evidence Used by: list, get, validation.

file_id.description: Evidence file UUID — obtain from scf_list_evidence_files Used by: get, validation.

method.description:
list: List all files uploaded or ingested for an evidence item. Returns filename, content type, upload timestamp, validation status, and a pre-signed download URL (15-min expiry).
get: Get metadata and a pre-signed download URL (15-min expiry) for a single evidence file. Use to inspect or retrieve a specific uploaded artifact.
validation: Get the validation result for a single evidence file: status (valid/warning/partial/invalid), completeness score, individual rule findings, source, and timestamp.
validation_summary: Get aggregate evidence validation metrics for the organization dashboard: total files validated, counts by status (valid/warning/partial/invalid), and overall pass rate.

name: scf_evidence_file_read
